subject: Third-party onboarding gates — MAP checkpoint: MSA redlines, order form, vendor setup
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-08-10T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Third-party onboarding gates — MAP checkpoint: MSA redlines, order form, vendor setup

Team,

Quick MAP checkpoint for NovusHealth ahead of this Friday's close call. High-level status:

- MSA redlines: Legal provided consolidated redline (attached). Key open items: data residency paragraph, indemnity cap language, and audit scope. Marissa is driving.
- Order form: Procurement has agreed to pricing, pending signature-ready OF with data residency checkbox. Draft attached.
- Vendor setup: IT/security asked for vendor portal invite + SOC 2 evidence. Novus needs an internal onboarding contact to accept portal invite.

Action items (owners):
- Marissa: produce clean MSA with comments addressed by EOD Wed (redline_msa_v3.docx)
- Karthik: confirm final order-form terms and add residency checkbox by Thu morning (order_form-v2.pdf)
- Lauren: confirm vendor portal contact and push SOC 2 evidence to Novus secure upload (vendor-setup-checklist.xlsx)
- Rafael (me): schedule Friday 11am PT close call and prepare fallback model variant language for SOW

Attachments: redline_msa_v3.docx, order_form-v2.pdf, vendor-setup-checklist.xlsx

Please reply with blockers or if you need me to escalate to leadership. I'll follow up with a one-page close timeline after we validate the cleaned MSA.

Thanks,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-11T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Third-party onboarding gates — MAP checkpoint: MSA redlines, order form, vendor setup

Rafael,

I've reviewed the redline and pulled the three law firm comments into a single clean document. Key notes:

- Indemnity cap: propose we keep cap at 3x fees but accept limited carveouts for security incidents (we'll mark exceptions explicitly).
- Data residency: Novus requested EU-only for a subset of data. I recommend adding a scoped residency appendix rather than changing core MSA language.
- Audit scope: replace 'full audit' with 'reasonable access to logs and SOC2 report' — cost-neutral and faster for them.

I'll attach the clean draft in the shared Drive link and will push edits into redline_msa_v3.docx. Expect clean copy by Wed 5pm PT.

Marissa

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Tom Avery <tom.avery@novushealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@blue-ridge-procure.com>
Date: 2027-08-12T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Third-party onboarding gates — MAP checkpoint: MSA redlines, order form, vendor setup

Rafael/Marissa,

Thanks for the clear summary. A few items from our side:

- Our IT lead (Sonia Patel cc'd) will accept the vendor portal invite, but she needs a point of contact for the SOC 2 upload (Sonia will coordinate dates)
- We can accept a scoped data residency appendix — confirm which data classes are in scope and timeline to deliver.
- DocuSign is preferred for the order form; can you give a target for the signed OF so we can schedule procurement release?

We are aiming for Aug 20th to have procurement sign-off; any slides that show the fallback SLA/variants would help our execs.

Tom

Tom Avery
Director, Vendor Management | NovusHealth
tom.avery@novushealth.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tom Avery <tom.avery@novushealth.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-13T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Third-party onboarding gates — MAP checkpoint: MSA redlines, order form, vendor setup

Tom,

Thanks — logistics below and current expectation:

- Vendor portal invite: sent today to sonia.patel@blue-ridge-procure.com. Sonia, expect an invite link with simple onboarding steps (ID, W9/COI if US entity, SOC 2 upload). ETA for portal completion: 2 business days after upload.
- Order form / DocuSign: Rafael will send the DocuSign package once Marissa confirms the final MSA text. Target for sending DocuSign: Thu 8/14 AM PT.
- Tax/Vendor setup: we will need a completed vendor setup form — I've attached a checklist (vendor-setup-checklist.xlsx). Please return by Fri EOD to hit Aug 20th close.

No blockers from procurement on pricing; just the standard vendor paperwork and residency appendix to be finalized.

Karthik

Karthik Iyer
Senior Program Manager, Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Third-party onboarding gates — MAP checkpoint: MSA redlines, order form, vendor setup

Tom/Sonia — thanks for the quick turn. Short checklist and next steps to lock the Aug 20th close:

1) Marissa to post clean MSA by Wed 8/14 5pm PT — if any last-minute comments emerge, flag immediately
2) Rafael to send DocuSign OF on Thu 8/14 AM PT
3) Sonia to complete portal upload + vendor form by Fri 8/15 EOD
4) Karthik to confirm vendor account and PO setup after OF is signed
5) Friday 8/20 11am PT — final close call (Rafael to calendar invite)

If everyone agrees to the timeline I'll send the DocuSign package on Thu morning and calendar invite for Friday. Rafael (me) will add a one-slide risk/fallback note for exec review.

Thanks,
Rafael
